_purpose: A mutating tool really changes the level, the change is visible to a later step, and the scenario puts the world back as it found it.
_note: Undo is deliberately not asserted here. run_scenario is itself a mutating tool, so the whole scenario runs inside ONE transaction - which means canUndo reads false while it is still executing, and afterwards the entire run collapses to a single 'Uplink: run_scenario' entry. That is the useful behaviour (a playtest undoes as one unit), but it makes undo untestable from the inside. Check it by hand with edit_history after a run.

steps._why: Clear any probe a previous aborted run left behind, so the count assertions below mean what they say. Deleting nothing is not an error.
